original.target_description: Published Slovic and Fischhoff (1977), Experiment 1: foresight versus hindsight judgments of future recurrence, with four scenarios and two initial outcomes per scenario. The supplied broad description and PDF-page-3 locator do not identify one scenario/outcome/test, or a printed omnibus comparison.

n.sample_role: Human volunteer participants; target-test analytic sample not established. Experiment-wide enrollment is not substituted for a test-specific sample.
n.location: Printed p. 546 (PDF p. 3), Subjects; printed p. 547 (PDF p. 4), Table 1 note.
n.quote: Group size varied from 24 to 37 subjects.

es.location: Printed p. 546 (PDF p. 3), Results; printed p. 547 (PDF p. 4), Table 1.
es.quote: In six of eight cases (two from each of four studies)

p.location: Printed p. 547 (PDF p. 4), Table 1, footnote b, Experiment 1 foresight column.
p.quote: Significance tests in this column refer to differences from one-alternative hindsight.

replication.target_description: Unassigned side; not examined in this original-only blind validation.

notes: Verified published article title and authors against supplied reference. Numerical target pages were visually checked against the scanned PDF, retaining the published version. Experiment 1 reports 184 volunteers overall on printed p. 546, with groups of 24 to 37; Table 1 covers Experiments 1 and 2 and reports sample sizes varying from 24 to 41. Neither supplies an identified combined analytic n for the broad target. Table 1 contains separate outcome-specific comparisons and significance thresholds, not a uniquely identified test for the supplied description. Results also provide descriptive average probabilities across three scenarios; no corresponding omnibus effect size/test statistic and p are printed there. Therefore no test-specific n, effect size, or p is selected or calculated. The source is available; the unresolved issue is locator specificity. Replication and reported_success intentionally remain unassigned placeholders.
